title: asperula cynanchica subsp. rupicola
intro: Asperula cynanchica subsp. rupicola, commonly known as Rock Woodruff, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is used as a medicinal herb due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties that may help in treating various health conditions. However, more research is needed to fully understand the potential therapeutic applications and health benefits of this plant.
